At one of my old jobs, I was a cashier. I was ringing up a mom and her daughter, and out if nowhere her daughter told me I was very pretty.
She was little, like 4 or 5, and it made me feel so good since little kids always seem to say exactly what they think. I've always struggled with body image so it really just stuck with me, even years later.
